-- name: SearchAccounts
-- param: @status account_status null
SELECT
    a.id,
    a.name,
    a.email,
    a.status,
    a.closed_at
FROM accounts a
WHERE
    (a.name ILIKE '%' || @q || '%' OR a.email ILIKE '%' || @q || '%')
    AND (@status::account_status IS NULL OR a.status = @status)
ORDER BY a.name
LIMIT @limit OFFSET @offset;
